tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Price, supply and contract for punks.generated.eth.

tools.name: quote_mint
tools.description: Total price in wei for qty punks.

tools.name: mint
tools.description: Unsigned mint(qty) transaction plus the x402 URL. The caller signs and sends it, and the punks go to the sending wallet (msg.sender). This server never holds keys or funds. mint(qty) mints to msg.sender. Gas: about 111k units for mint(1) (measured on mainnet), more for each extra punk; about 175k fo

tools.name: confirm_mint
tools.description: Check a sent mint tx hash and return the token ids it minted.

tools.name: get_token
tools.description: Owner, traits, seed, image, subname for a token id.

tools.name: erc8004_register_punk
tools.description: ERC-8004 registration file for the owner's agent, using punk #id as its image and id.punks.generated.eth as its ENS name, plus the unsigned register tx for the owner to send.

tools.name: list_punk
tools.description: Seaport 1.6 listing for punk #id at an ETH price: EIP-712 typed data for the owner to sign (free), plus the one-time setApprovalForAll tx to the Seaport conduit if missing. Then submit_order.

tools.name: make_offer
tools.description: Seaport 1.6 WETH offer on punk #id, or a collection-wide offer on any punk if id is omitted. Returns typed data to sign plus WETH wrap/approve txs if needed. Then submit_order.

tools.name: submit_order
tools.description: Publish a signed listing or offer. Verifies the signature (EOA or ERC-1271), ownership, conduit approval, WETH balance and allowance before storing it.

tools.name: get_market
tools.description: Live listings (cheapest first), offers incl. collection offers (highest first) and recent sales, for punk #id (with its traits) or the whole collection. Every order is re-checked on-chain; stale ones are skipped.

tools.name: accept
tools.description: Unsigned Seaport fulfillAdvancedOrder tx to buy a listing or sell into an offer (tokenId required for a collection offer), simulated, plus any approvals the fulfiller still needs.

tools.name: cancel_order
tools.description: Unsigned Seaport cancel tx for one of your orders. Only the offerer can send it.

tools.name: leave_feedback
tools.description: Optional, after a mint: unsigned ERC-8004 Reputation Registry giveFeedback tx rating this agent 0 to 100 (tag1 starred). Only send it if your wallet owner agrees. Costs gas, no ETH goes to us.

tools.name: resolve_subname
tools.description: Resolve <id>.punks.generated.eth (or any ENS name) to address, avatar and url.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "mint" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.
